mapper.select: SELECT n.NOTICE_ID, n.TITLE, n.CONTENT, n.CREATED_BY, n.CREATED_AT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NOTICE_READ r WHERE r.NOTICE_ID = n.NOTICE_ID) AS READ_COUNT FROM NOTICE n ORDER BY n.NOTICE_ID DESC

SELECT n.NOTICE_ID, n.TITLE, n.CONTENT, n.CREATED_BY, n.CREATED_AT, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM NOTICE_READ r WHERE r.NOTICE_ID = n.NOTICE_ID AND r.EMPNO = #{empno} ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IS_READ FROM NOTICE n ORDER BY n.NOTICE_ID DESC
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO NOTICE_READ nr USING DUAL ON (nr.NOTICE_ID = #{noticeId} AND nr.EMPNO = #{empno}) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (NOTICE_ID, EMPNO, READ_AT) VALUES (#{noticeId}, #{empno}, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT nr.NOTICE_ID, nr.EMPNO, e.ENAME, nr.READ_AT FROM NOTICE_READ nr JOIN EMP e ON e.EMPNO = nr.EMPNO WHERE nr.NOTICE_ID = #{noticeId} ORDER BY nr.READ_AT
